reference: Hand-built single-section trench scenarios around one fully-controlled baseline (2.0 m deep, 0.9 m wide, trench box with design basis, dry, ladder at 5 m, barriers, full buried-service evidence, pre-shift inspection), each mutated once: no-pack and custom-pack acceptance criteria; 29 CFR 1926 Subpart P thresholds (5 ft protective system, Table B-1 slopes by class, 20 ft engineered design, 2 ft edge setback, 4 ft / 25 ft egress) and DIN 4124 values as reproduced in DGUV Information 201-052 (1.25 m vertical, 45/60/80 deg, 0.60 m strip) with vehicle distances from a secondary summary, each on both sides of its threshold; unverified ground class; generic services / water / access / inspection / edge-load evidence gaps; no-cancel cases; invalid input; and 5 seeded random slope cases. tolerance: Rule statuses and booleans exact. Where the sources only establish that an item must stay open, the check is the boolean '<topic>_open' (any of finding / review required / insufficient data passes; 'no finding' or 'not applicable' fails), because the sources prescribe the obligation, not the tool's grading word. Threshold comparisons follow the literal source wording ('at least', 'no more than', 'less than', 'bis', 'greater than') and boundary cases sit 0.01 m / 0.01 H:V beside the limit, above the display resolution of cm inputs. Slope angle abs 0.01 deg: the display resolution of a degree value shown to two decimals; the arithmetic itself is exact to 1e-12. Cases marked DISPUTABLE in their derivation are to be recorded as flagged, not as failures, if the tool disagrees.

not_benchmarked.DIN 4124 vehicle distances: DIN 4124 vehicle distances: the DIN text was not read; values from one secondary summary only (cases marked DISPUTABLE)
not_benchmarked.DIN 4124 other provisions: DIN 4124 behaviour above 40 t, deep (>5 m) slopes, surface slope/site conditions, access rules - no source read
not_benchmarked.OSHA tables not modelled: OSHA short-term Type A 1/2:1 slope, benching, Appendix C/D timber/hydraulic shoring tables - not modelled by tool, not tested
not_benchmarked.BS 5975 and EN 1997: BS 5975 and EN 1997-1/-2 content - not read; their generic rules are tested only through OSHA/HSE equivalents or acceptance criteria
not_benchmarked.HSE HSG150: HSG150 text not read; HSE excavations topic page used instead
not_benchmarked.Influence zone heuristic: the 1:1 influence-zone heuristic beyond 'close load stays open' - it is a tool heuristic, no source threshold
not_benchmarked.Drawing and interface: drawing legibility at mobile/print, drag interaction, PDF content, permalink round-trip - UI, not a reference question
not_benchmarked.Geotechnical design: earth pressure, support capacity, geotechnical design - out of scope

coverage: Covers the spec's headline claims: no-pack -> no numeric compliance claim; thresholds only from a sourced pack with source/jurisdiction shown; both national packs' numeric thresholds on both sides; unverified ground class; edge loads (spoil, plant, structure, over-opening, missing distance/mass); water presence/control; access/egress and travel; exclusion and barriers; services locate/mark/trial-hole/permit evidence; inspection; no-cancel of services/water by shoring and access; negative and insufficient-data input.

self_tests.note: window.__safetyTests() passes on the same build: every rule ID with boundary, negative and missing-data cases.

adapter.note: Reference inputs pass through sanitize(), the import path, then evaluate(), the function the interface calls; free-text and aggregated inputs are mapped as stated in each case note.

harness.note: qa.sh: manifest, catalogue, 1280/390 px in seven languages, reports in seven languages, permalink round-trip, artifact regeneration.
